title: Weeknote #2025
summary: Panda pen cases, no context searches, and a canamera
content:
A plague has descended upon the Knight household. 0/10, would not recommend.

Update 2026-11-09

The post mentioned below was by Sophie — Everything I googled in a week as a professional software engineer

I remembered a post I now can't find where a developer listed everything they had searched for in a week[1] and thought it would be fun to include some searches I've done this week with zero context.

  • marry me pasta
  • words than end in go
  • hanging chads
  • triscuit biscuit

I bought a Legami Super Kawaii pen case designed to hold 100 Legami pens but I needed it for my mildliners. Here it is with just over 60 in it. Also, it's a panda.

I sold my Kodak Charmera for two reasons: one, I knew I'd never really use it again and two, I could sell it on Vinted for what I paid for it but then I bought The Jaffa cake camera — more on that in another post.

As soon as I sent the Jaffa cam to Ben, a fellow novelty camera enjoyer, he replied with another camera I now want — the Godex C100 which has a transparent viewfinder and looks cool af.

This Ghostbusters × Wild Wild West mashup is glorious.

It's been three years since Duel of the Defaults and the post collection is up to 539 posts. Wild.

Pablo wrote a lovely post about the good internet.

I lost more time than I care to admit playing Katamari Met — Katamari Damacy but for objects from The Metropolitan Museum of Art's open object collection. I scored 15k on my first run.

This GitHub issue complaining because their little robot didn't do as it was told and deleted loads of stuff is absolute cinema. Poor baby.

Ben posted about Thai colours of the day. I should try this as a way to get through more of my ink.

While viewing a school for Baby Knight, the teacher (who was teaching six year olds) asked them to say what a "digraph" was and I went into full panic because I had never heard that word in my life. Why did I think she was going to ask me? No idea. Anyway, it's two consonants that join to make a unique sound like "sh".

I want the Pepsi Canamera (not a typo) more than anything right now. Can't stop thinking about it.

  1. If anyone knows what post I'm on about, please send it my way ⤾
